newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX BRENT WEAKER IN LATE TRADING.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX BRENT WEAKER IN LATE TRADING.

text.p: September Brent futures were weaker in late trading on Friday, still driven by news of imminent Iraqi crude exports.
September Brent on SIMEX last traded $18.86 per barrel, down four cents, after London fell 30 cents overnight.
Iraq was expected to start exporting by as early as next week, which has dragged Brent prices down in two consecutive days.
With the uptrend support of $18.90 having been tested and broken, brokers expected prices to slip further when IPE opened.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded one cent higher from New York, at $20.10.
Brokers expected WTI to remain steady, with some shortcovering of WTI ahead of the weekend, due to technical overselling earlier.
